text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 104,289 to 96,031 overall, so I should accept that stock values can decline and avoid assuming recent moves predict what comes next.","I made no trades, which avoided impulsive reactions, but I should review whether my holdings and risk level still suit my needs rather than staying inactive by default.","I should make decisions based on my goals and the information available now, not on average cost or an attempt to recover past losses."]}
